name: pipeline_softmode_215
purpose: TASKS 225, the rehearsal: the pipeline end to end on a molecule that has a soft mode, with step 3 on pyscf 2.15.0. furan+vinyl (B_1e0fa2d7f0, 13 atoms, SMILES C=Cc1ccoc1) is the smallest of the 58 molecules whose label the low-mode repair changed on 14 November, so this is the case the pipeline cannot do today: on 2.14.0 the route's repair stops at `grid_response_blocked`'s refusal, and a molecule like this is exactly what the supervisor may pick on 25 November (decision 64). Every step is computed (--no-reuse) and no interpreter is named, so the run tests the default the demo will use; afterwards `probes/pipeline_vs_corpus.py <result> B_1e0fa2d7f0` reads it against the corpus row
command: env CORPUS_QC_PYTHON=C:/Users/thebr/.conda/envs/qc/python.exe PYTHONUTF8=1 python -m m08.pipeline --name furan_vinyl --smiles C=Cc1ccoc1 --out ../../probes/results_m1/pipeline_softmode_215_2026-11-14 --threads 6 --psi4-memory-gb 4 --wsl-cap-mb 6144 --no-reuse

estimate.basis: benzene's 324 s on 3 November for twelve atoms, plus the low-mode repair's two displaced grid-response gradients for this molecule's one soft direction

memory.basis: as pipeline_benzene_computed: the WSL step runs under probes/wsl_capped.sh at 6144 MB; psi4 is given 4 GB and runs before it, not beside it
